crystal.line: You can burn sage and I'll cleanse the crystals
stanza: Transcendental in your meditations (Love and light)
You can burn sage and I'll cleanse the crystals
We can get high, but only if the wind blows (Blows just right)

pistol.line: One flash of light, but no smoking pistol
stanza: Time and again, I tell myself
But the little green wheels are following me
I'm stuck with a valuable friend
One flash of light, but no smoking pistol

pistol.line: See, what these kids do is hear about us totin' pistols
pistol.linePrev: Just tell the judge it was my fault, and I'll get sued
pistol.lineNext: And they wanna get one 'cause they think this shit's cool

pistol.line: Saw a prisoner take a pistol
stanza: I saw flowers on a hillside
And a millionaire pissing on the lawn
Saw a prisoner take a pistol
And say join me in song, join me in song
